messages:
Priya K: Quick heads-up — EU change window starts 02:00 UTC. Leaving a short readiness checklist below, please react with :thumbsup: when you're green. Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 30m if no regression.

Priya K: CHECKLIST:
```
- All release notes uploaded to /releases/2026-03
- DB migrations have dry-run + rollback scripts
- Model pin applied for prod (model-v2.3.1-quant)
- Canary route configured (eu, 10%)
- Ops oncall ready and monitoring links posted
- Post-deploy smoke tests (latency, error-rate, 95th p99 mem)
```

Marco G: Pinning question — do we pin to the exact build hash or the tag?

Sarah L: Pin the hash for the canary, tag for gradual rollout. Use: `/deploy pin redwood-inference:model@sha256:9f3a2b`

deploy-bot: /deploy pin acknowledged: redwood-inference:model@sha256:9f3a2b pinned by Sarah L at 1769801150

Jason M: Rollback criteria suggestion: if error-rate > 1.5% for 5m OR latency p95 increases > 2x baseline, we rollback to previous model. Agree?

Sarah L: Agree. Add token-quality check: embedding drift > 4% on control prompts -> rollback. I'll add to the runbook.

ops-oncall: I'll be on watch during the window and will escalate to SRE if alerts hit. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/mon/launch-1769

Priya K: Small note: disabling autoscale burst for first 15m to avoid noisy autoscale metrics. We'll re-enable after 30m.

Marco G: Is there a deploy-bot step for canary -> 30%? or manual?

Sarah L: Manual advance for now. We need to verify quality evals in the first canary batch before increasing.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: redwood-inference:model@sha256:9f3a2b -> eu cluster (10%) at 1769801200

Priya K: Running smoke tests now. Posting results in 5.

Sarah L: Quick reminder — include the release-notes snippet in the support template so CS can triage any new behavior: https://docs.redwood/release-templates

Jason M: If we see a slow degradation (gradual error slope), prefer pin+stop-routing rather than immediate rollback to ensure stateful caches warm. Add that to ops steps.

ops-oncall: Smoke results: latency p50 48ms (baseline 46), p95 180ms (baseline 170), errors 0.3%. All green from infra side.

Priya K: Thanks — canary looks healthy at 10%. Waiting 10m to collect more quality evals, then we'll move to 30%.

Marco G: FYI I pushed the DB migration dry-run logs to the release folder. No schema drift detected.

deploy-bot: Canary expand scheduled: awaiting manual confirmation to move to 30% at 1769801400

Sarah L: Confirm moving to 30% in 5. :thumbsup:

Priya K: Moving to 30% now. ops-oncall keep eyes open.

deploy-bot: Canary expand executed: 30% traffic at 1769801425

ops-oncall: Monitoring — small bump in p95 to 195ms but still within rollback threshold. No increase in request errors.

Jason M: Quality eval batch 1 results: embedding drift 1.1%, semantic similarity pass rate 98.6%. Looks good to me.

Priya K: Great. Proceeding to full rollout in 25m if no regression. Post-deploy notes will be pushed to #release-notes when finished.

Marco G: Leaving a note for postmortem: capture the manual canary advance decision and the autoscale toggle, both were manual ops that helped stabilize metrics.

Sarah L: Agreed. If anything odd pops up, ping me directly.

Priya K: Thanks all — will post final OK or rollback if any issue in next 30m. :rocket:
